newsitem.title: BELGIUM: French vote speculation to steer Belgian OLOs.
newsitem.headline: French vote speculation to steer Belgian OLOs.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds, marginally lower in Thursday's slow session, will take taking their cue on Friday mainly from speculation about Sunday's second round of voting in the French parliamentary elections.

Thursday was dominated by worries that Bonn's Buba gold revaluation plan and a possible victory of the Left at the French elections would upset the EMU project and cause an unwinding of convergence plays.

The 2007 OLO yield ended at 6.03 percent, up from 5.99, an unchanged eight basis points over Bunds. The spread is seen staying around this level as any attempt on narrowing has been swiftly countered by London selling in the past few days.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810, Fax +32 2 230 7710
